newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African holiday death toll rises to 1,075.
newsitem.headline: S.African holiday death toll rises to 1,075.

text.p: At least 1,075 people have died in road accidents during South Africa's Christmas holiday break this year, dramatically higher than the comparative death toll for 1995, officials said on Sunday.
A total of 765 people died over the holiday period in 1995, calculated from December 3, 1995 to January 3, 1996, traffic officials said in a statement.

Officials said they expected this year's toll to rise even further as the last holiday-makers returned home this weekend to the industrial heartland around Johannesburg after their summer vacations at coastal resorts.
Most fatalities were caused by head-on collisions and pedestrians being run over due to speeding and drunk-driving.
